user.title: Media Utopia Configuration
user.description: Configure the connection to your Media Utopia system.

data_description.topic_base: The base MQTT topic used by Media Utopia (default: mu/v1).
data_description.discovery_prefix: The MQTT discovery prefix for Home Assistant (default: homeassistant).
data_description.identity: Identity string for this controller (default: homeassistant).
data_description.playlist_refresh_seconds: How often to refresh playlists from the server (default: 30).
data_description.artwork_base_url: Override base URL for artwork images. Leave empty to auto-detect.
